EoCClient.dll+0xD36CA0 ecl::GameAnalyticsSystem::RecordCombatStart: ls::Guid::ToString(+8) -> "faction_id", FactionContainer lookup of +8 -> "faction_name". Live: 5 distinct 16-byte values, identical on client and server.

RecordCombatStart: STDString +0x30 -> "combat_group_id". Live: mostly empty (size 0, capacity 15) or 36 chars.
alignment padding before the next string; live holds stale bytes

RecordCombatStart: int at +0x68 -> "initiative". Live small values and 0xFFFFFFEF.. (negative allowed).
tail padding to 8-byte alignment (112); live holds stale bytes
